signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a split-level house frontage with lawn, driveway and street; the house is partly screened by trees.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Fresh dark mulch rings around the trees and ornamental grass, and a trimmed row of shrubs along the foundation, but this is also typical of homeowner upkeep. No crew or equipment is visible.

signals.notes: Well-kept split-level home with a lush green lawn, mulched beds and two dark SUVs in the asphalt driveway, which has a paver apron; nothing here suggests a sale or active work.
